category: Apply Build Hardening for AI Artefacts (PW)
subcategory_text: Apply build hardening to AI artefacts (signed model cards, locked container images, hermetic builds for model compilation, signed datasets) to preserve reproducibility and detect tampering.
informative_references: NIST SSDF v1.1: PW.4.1, PW.4.3, PS.2.1
implementation_examples: Build container images with pinned digests
Record the training-data hash in the model card
Produce hermetic builds that don't fetch network resources at compile time
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AI artefacts are built with reproducibility and integrity guarantees.
Determine whether build provenance is captured per release.
